title: Durable runner activity reads worker.sqlite mtime, but pi-durable writes WAL
body:
LastStorageEvent stats worker.sqlite. pi-durable 1.0.2 opens node SQLite with journal_mode=WAL and wal_autocheckpoint=1000, so commits land in worker.sqlite-wal and the main file's mtime stays put until a checkpoint. The conversation therefore barely counts as an activity signal. A worker that is thinking or reading for a long time is steered as stuck, and later stopped. Stat the -wal file too, or use the newer of the two.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/activity.go:324-331; pi-durable dist/storage/sqlite/node.js:160-162
